title: Binding Affinity of HIV-1 Protease Inhibitors: Insights from Machine Learning Models of Crystallographic Structures
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习基于晶体结构预测HIV-1蛋白酶-抑制剂结合亲和力，对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽含AI但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: HIV-1 protease inhibitors are major players among the antiviral therapies used against acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS). As such, the crystallographic coordinates of hundreds of HIV-1 protease complexes with miscellaneous ligands have been resolved and uploaded to the Protein Data Bank. Herein, machine learning (ML) models were constructed based on the crystallographic coordinates of 291 HIV-1 protease inhibitor complexes and >2500 molecular descriptors and subsequently used to predict the binding affinity of 274 additional HIV-1 protease–inhibitor complexes for which inhibition constants were not measured. The resulting accuracy scores of the ML models were >0.85. Three ML models, each based on 8–9 features, were analyzed in detail. These models were based on KBest with Random Forest, Recursive Feature Elimination with Random Forest, and Sequential Feature Selection with Support Vector Machine. The strength of our ML models lies in their ability to capture the chemical essence of key factors that influence binding. These include HIV-1 protease–inhibitor properties related to charge distribution, ability to form hydrogen bonds, and three-dimensional topology. Additionally, our models consider important properties of HIV-1 protease, including the symmetry of its active site and mutations in its flaps. The findings of the study highlight the contribution of a comprehensive analysis of accumulated experimental data to enhance the structural understanding of this important molecular system.
abstract_zh: HIV-1蛋白酶抑制剂是针对获得性免疫缺陷综合征（AIDS）的抗病毒治疗中的主要药物。因此，数百个HIV-1蛋白酶与多种配体复合物的晶体学坐标已被解析并上传至蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank）。在此，基于291个HIV-1蛋白酶抑制剂复合物的晶体学坐标和超过2500个分子描述符，构建了机器学习（ML）模型，并随后用于预测274个额外HIV-1蛋白酶-抑制剂复合物的结合亲和力，这些复合物的抑制常数尚未被测量。所得ML模型的准确度评分大于0.85。详细分析了三个ML模型，每个模型基于8-9个特征。这些模型分别基于KBest与随机森林（Random Forest）、递归特征消除与随机森林，以及序列特征选择与支持向量机（Support Vector Machine）。我们ML模型的优势在于其能够捕捉影响结合的关键因素的化学本质。这些因素包括与电荷分布、形成氢键能力及三维拓扑结构相关的HIV-1蛋白酶-抑制剂特性。此外，我们的模型还考虑了HIV-1蛋白酶的重要特性，包括其活性位点的对称性和其瓣膜中的突变。研究结果强调了综合分析积累的实验数据对于增强这一重要分子系统结构理解的贡献。
